title: Signal
tagline: Alien glyphs. A dish goes quiet.
blurb: Swap neighboring glyphs. Three in a line clear and count toward the log. Four leaves a beam that wipes a line; five leaves a nova. Crates crack when a clear lands beside them. Four logs, one mystery.

levels.brief: Log 1. The dish stutters. Gather rust rings and tide triangles.
Log 2. Crates jam the panel. Match beside a crate to crack it. Moss diamonds and flare stars.
Log 3. A line of four forges a beam. Line up five and the nova punches a hole.
Log 4. Last packet: every glyph once more, then the dish should answer.
